External network and VPN
==========

Connect a device with the trailer using OpenVPN
-----------------------------------------------

How to get a connection to the trailer on your computer / smartphone. You need to have sudo access on fb09-pasig and know the password
of the trailer terminal and administration rights on your device. Don't know what that means? Find somebody (eg. Philipp) who can do it.

 1. Install OpenVPN on your device. For Windows you get it here: https://openvpn.net/index.php/open-source/downloads.html
 2. Visit fb09-pasig.umwelt.uni-giessen.de with putty and change to the directory /etc/openvpn
 3. Start `sudo make-client client w`, where client is the new client name and w indicates you do it for Windows. 
    For other devices omit the w
 4. The script creates a zip-file in ~/vpn. Copy that script file to the client
 5. Unpack the script file on the client. The password is the same as for the trailer ssh connection
 6. Copy the content to the OpenVPN directory on your device. In Windows it is c:\programs\openvpn\config
 7. Restart OpenVPN and your done.

The trailer is now at the IP-Address 10.8.0.6. If you want a nicer name, eg. `trailer`, in Windows you can edit with admin privileges 
the file `C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts` and add the line: `10.8.0.6    trailer`
 
 

VPN topology (aka IP-Addresses)
---------------------------------

The trailer is on 10.8.0.6 / 10.42.0.1. Other trailer devices are still not accessable from outside in the 10.42.0.x network.
